BMI_GT_30.name: Overweight/Obese
BMI_GT_30.reason: Excess adiposity increases cardiovascular risk, exacerbates hypertension, increases diabetes risk, and increases joint stress.

BMI_25_30.name: Overweight
BMI_25_30.reason: Modest weight loss can improve blood pressure control and metabolic parameters.

SEDENTARY.name: Sedentary Lifestyle
SEDENTARY.reason: Physical inactivity is a major risk factor for cardiovascular disease and metabolic syndrome.
SEDENTARY.recommendation: Start with 150 minutes of moderate activity per week, as tolerated. Consult with healthcare provider before starting new exercise program.

LIGHT_ACTIVITY.name: Light Activity
LIGHT_ACTIVITY.reason: Light activity level provides some cardiovascular benefit.

MODERATE_ACTIVITY.name: Moderate Activity
MODERATE_ACTIVITY.reason: Regular moderate activity supports cardiovascular health and metabolic control.

AGE_GT_60.name: Age > 60 years
AGE_GT_60.reason: Older adults have increased nutrient needs and higher risk of micronutrient deficiencies.
AGE_GT_60.special_considerations: Consider digestive changes with age; smaller, more frequent meals may be beneficial.

AGE_GT_75.name: Age > 75 years
AGE_GT_75.reason: Very elderly patients need higher nutrient density due to reduced appetite and absorption changes.
AGE_GT_75.special_considerations: Small frequent meals, easy-to-chew options, attention to swallowing if needed.

DIABETES_TYPE_2.name: Type 2 Diabetes
DIABETES_TYPE_2.reason: Low glycemic index foods minimize postprandial glucose spikes and reduce insulin demand.

HYPERTENSION_STAGE_2.name: Stage 2 Hypertension
HYPERTENSION_STAGE_2.reason: Severe hypertension requires aggressive sodium reduction and DASH protocol adherence.

HYPERLIPIDEMIA.name: High Cholesterol
HYPERLIPIDEMIA.condition: Diagnosis includes Hyperlipidemia or High Cholesterol
HYPERLIPIDEMIA.reason: Mediterranean diet has strongest evidence for LDL reduction and cardiovascular protection.

CHRONIC_KIDNEY_DISEASE.name: Chronic Kidney Disease
CHRONIC_KIDNEY_DISEASE.condition: Diagnosis includes CKD or Kidney Disease
CHRONIC_KIDNEY_DISEASE.reason: Renal-friendly diet reduces filtration burden and prevents electrolyte imbalances.

CELIAC_DISEASE.name: Celiac Disease
CELIAC_DISEASE.condition: Diagnosis includes Celiac Disease or Gluten Sensitivity
CELIAC_DISEASE.reason: Complete gluten elimination is the only treatment for celiac disease.

CARDIOVASCULAR_DISEASE.name: Established Cardiovascular Disease
CARDIOVASCULAR_DISEASE.condition: Diagnosis includes Heart Disease, CAD, or Prior MI
CARDIOVASCULAR_DISEASE.reason: Mediterranean diet has strongest evidence for secondary prevention after cardiac events.

METABOLIC_SYNDROME.name: Metabolic Syndrome
METABOLIC_SYNDROME.reason: Metabolic syndrome benefits from combined glucose control, sodium reduction, and weight management.
